title: Noord Wool Overcoat
description: Double-breasted, cut with a full lapel and flap pockets, in a dense Italian wool melton. Wears over a jacket without pulling across the back.

specs.care: Dry clean only. Brush after wear.

title: Spui Wool Jacket
description: A single-breasted wool jacket, cut clean through the body with covered buttons. No bulk at the shoulder, plain enough to wear under a coat or on its own.

title: Dijk Peacoat
description: A double-breasted wool peacoat, flap pockets and a deep collar, nothing else. The wool softens after a week — cut close enough for the bike, plain enough for the office.

specs.care: Dry clean only. Brush after wear.

title: IJ Wool Jacket
description: A single-breasted wool jacket, cut clean with notch lapels and welt pockets, fully lined. Plain enough to wear over anything else here.

title: Vecht Field Jacket
description: A long field coat with a storm flap, twin epaulettes and a collar that stands without help. Cut wide enough for a knit underneath.

specs.material: Waxed cotton with a water-resistant finish
specs.care: Sponge clean. Rewax once a year.

title: Sluis Leather Coat
description: A belted coat in soft matte leather, cut for a wet ride home — layers clean enough to walk straight into the office once you're dry.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition yearly. Never machine wash.

title: Havik Wool Blazer
description: A single-breasted wool jacket with a checked lining and flap pockets. Cut straight through the body, plain at the collar.

title: Wal Wool Coat
description: A single-breasted swing coat in soft wool with a checked lining, cut loose through the body. Wears open as easily as buttoned.

title: Doorn Rain Coat
description: A long, unlined rain coat with sealed seams and vents under the arm. Last of the previous colour.

specs.care: Machine wash 30°. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.

title: Kaap Cardigan
description: A cropped cardigan in brushed lambswool with horn buttons. Cut to be worn open.

title: Merino Crew
description: The plain crew, in extrafine merino, cut long with a contrast cuff. Wears alone or under everything else here.

specs.material: 100% extrafine merino wool, contrast cuff trim
specs.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat. Do not wring.

title: Zand Ribbed V-Neck
description: A ribbed V-neck knitted in a heathered wool-cotton blend. Substantial in the hand, plain at the shoulder.

title: Winter Knit Gloves
description: Long knitted gloves in fine-gauge wool, finished with a fold at the cuff. For the coldest six weeks of the year.

title: Nes Knit Polo
description: Three buttons, a soft collar, and a straight hem meant to be worn out. Knitted in a dry-handling cotton.

specs.care: Machine wash 30° on wool cycle. Dry flat.

title: Veld Leather Tote
description: One compartment, two handles, a laptop sleeve inside. Cut from a single hide so the grain runs continuously.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition twice a year.

title: Kade Leather Bomber
description: A soft lambskin bomber with a ribbed collar, cuff and hem. Heavier than it looks on the hanger.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition yearly.

title: Haven Canvas Pack
description: A canvas backpack with a fold-over flap and two adjustable straps, sized for a laptop and a change of clothes.

specs.care: Spot clean with a damp cloth. Do not machine wash.

title: Riem Belt
description: Thirty millimetres of vegetable-tanned leather with a steel frame buckle and five hand-punched holes.

specs.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Condition yearly.

title: Damrak Suede Boots
description: Over-the-knee boots in brushed suede with a pointed toe and flat sole. Cut close through the leg, easy to walk in despite the height.

specs.care: Brush after wear. Store with boot trees. Avoid the rain.
